leadingCandidates.summary: Epoch 2 of 8: Non-Invasive ALSA Hardware Discovery (Peak MIDI 1 hw:3,0,0, UMC1820 hw:0,0,0, nanoKONTROL2 hw:2,0,0), Safety Clamping, NRPN/Dual-CC Router & Bidirectional OSC Server (Target: crates/synth-midi-osc; Related: src/midi.rs, src/hardware_verify.rs). Implement read-only /proc/asound/cards and /proc/asound/seq/clients inspection in crates/synth-midi-osc and src/hardware_verify.rs detecting Focusrite A.E Peak (Peak MIDI 1, hw:3,0,0, client 28, USB ID 1235:007e), UMC1820 MIDI 1 (hw:0,0,0, client 16), and Korg nanoKONTROL2 (hw:2,0,0, client 24) with safe virtual loopback default (never sending unprompted MIDI bytes to hw:3,0,0 or hw:0,0,0 during tests). Implement Novation Peak MIDI Channel 1 router (7-bit CC, +32 bipolar dual-CC, 14-bit NRPN, Bank Select CC0/CC32 + Program Change, and Focusrite/Novation 00 20 29 SysEx patch dump codec), self-oscillation/overdrive safety clamp (safe_sweep_range on CCs 29, 36, 79, 80, 104, 110), and bidirectional UDP OSC server (/peak/osc/{1..3}/*, /peak/filter/*, /peak/env/*, /peak/lfo/*, /peak/fx/*, /peak/animate/{1,2}, /peak/panic) with unit tests. Ensure all workspace tests pass (CARGO_BUILD_JOBS=2 cargo test --workspace and npm test). Write reports/report-002.md and compile it with /home/renick/claude/html-report-generator/build-report.sh --pdf.
